statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete across seven representative paths. Reader content pages beyond one sampled chapter, authenticated account flows, uploads, search and destructive account actions were not covered because they are redundant templates or require credentials.

page.notes: Server-rendered Spanish manga catalogue and reader. Representative coverage includes listing, detail, chapter, reading, registration and 404 templates.

checkOutcomes.method: a screenshot or computed background under an emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark condition will reveal whether surfaces re-tint; the page CSS / a color-scheme declaration is corroborating evidence. The model chooses the method.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The dark-emulation screenshot is visually identical to the light capture; computed html color-scheme is normal and the page background remains light.

checkOutcomes.method: a transition video, or an in-page probe of getAnimations()/computed animation under an emulated prefers-reduced-motion: reduce condition, can show whether motion stops. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Reduced-motion emulation was active; document.getAnimations() returned none, so no non-essential motion persisted.

checkOutcomes.method: a screenshot under emulated prefers-contrast: more / forced-colors, or an axe/contrast probe, can show whether controls and text survive. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Representative screenshots, DOM/runtime probes, Lighthouse, network and interaction evidence directly supported respect-user-preferences/respects-contrast on the audited paths.

checkOutcomes.method: a transition video of a route/state change shows whether it animates; the page source / ::view-transition usage corroborates. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The CSS/runtime probe found no View Transition declarations on the listing/detail journey.

checkOutcomes.method: source/CSS inspection for animation-timeline: scroll()/view(); a long-task / scroll-handler probe can flag the main-thread anti-pattern. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No scroll-linked animation exists on the representative pages, so there is no scroll-animation implementation to judge.
checkOutcomes.reason: No scroll-linked animation exists on the representative pages, so there is no scroll-animation implementation to judge.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS inspection for scroll-snap / overscroll-behavior / physics-based easing vs custom pointermove listeners. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited browse, detail, registration and reader flows expose no gesture-driven control.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited browse, detail, registration and reader flows expose no gesture-driven control.

checkOutcomes.method: a transition video of scrolling, or CSS inspection for scroll-state container queries. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage is about 34,841 CSS px tall on mobile, while screenshots and CSS inspection show static navigation and no progress or scroll-state treatment.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS inspection for anchor-name / position-anchor / position-try on overlays; a screenshot of an open overlay near a viewport edge can show drift. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip, popover or anchored menu was present in the exercised paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip, popover or anchored menu was present in the exercised paths.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS inspection for ::highlight / scroll-marker; a transition video can show whether attention is cued after navigation. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The chapter landing provides clearly labelled INICIAR LECTURA and VER CAPÍTULOS actions, preserving orientation between detail and reader.

checkOutcomes.method: a screenshot on load, or a DOM probe for full-viewport overlays present before interaction. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Desktop, mobile, detail, registration and reader screenshots show content immediately with no obstructing interstitial.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/source inspection for popover / <dialog> / <details> vs custom overlay divs with manual dismiss handling. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No overlay or transient rich control appeared in the representative paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No overlay or transient rich control appeared in the representative paths.

checkOutcomes.method: a screenshot plus layout metrics can show the proportion of the viewport given to chrome vs content. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Screenshots show a compact 68 px navigation bar and content-dominant listing/detail layouts.

checkOutcomes.method: layout metrics (scrollWidth vs innerWidth) and a screenshot at an emulated narrow mobile viewport reveal overflow. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: At 360x800, layout measured scrollWidth 360, clientWidth 360 and zero horizontal overflow on home and reader.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS inspection for @container / container-type; a computed-style probe of the same component in a wide vs narrow container shows whether it adapts. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The runtime CSS probe found no @container rules even though cards and update rows appear in multiple column widths.

checkOutcomes.method: a focus probe (focus an element, read the computed outline) or an axe target-size check; a screenshot of a focused control corroborates. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: After programmatically focusing the first control, its computed outline is none; the mobile screenshot confirms the toggle is a primary control.

checkOutcomes.method: screenshot the first viewport and key scrolled states; inspect heading structure, nav labels, button text, and visual hierarchy; a task walkthrough can show whether the next action is obvious. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The first viewport identifies popular Spanish manga and exposes title/chapter links; chapter detail labels the reading action.

checkOutcomes.method: run the flow manually with screenshots/DOM snapshots at each step; compare expected vs actual path length; inspect form requirements, navigation continuity, and blockers. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The exercised home → chapter detail → /manga/leer/725822 journey reached the reading view through real href links.

checkOutcomes.method: exercise network delay/failure, invalid input, empty data and success states; screenshot the state messaging and recovery controls; inspect whether browser history and focus remain sensible. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The invalid registration form exposes native required-field messages, and the 404 page gives a clear missing-content explanation and navigation.

checkOutcomes.method: the layout primitive records long tasks; a heap summary shows the object population; Lighthouse reports TBT. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Trace found one 61 ms long task and only 11 ms total blocking time.

checkOutcomes.method: a HAR summary can reveal cache headers, redirects, render-blocking candidates, weight offenders and dependency shape; a trace/Lighthouse insight report can corroborate LCP discovery, render-blocking, font-display and document latency. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HAR recorded 634 requests and 12,928,452 transferred bytes, including 602 image requests and 12,195,824 image bytes; Lighthouse estimates 8,318 KiB cache and 3,255 KiB image-delivery savings.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse/trace/code-coverage style evidence can flag unused JS/CSS, duplicated JavaScript and legacy code; a HAR summary shows third-party byte cost and request count. The model chooses.

checkOutcomes.method: axe-core (injectable via the evaluate primitive) or Lighthouse's a11y audits enumerate these; a DOM probe of the accessibility-relevant attributes is a first-party alternative. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Images have alt text, registration inputs have associated labels, and Lighthouse did not flag name/role/label failures.

checkOutcomes.method: axe contrast rules, a Lighthouse contrast audit, or an in-page probe computing contrast ratios from computed colours. The model chooses.

checkOutcomes.reason: No permission prompt fired, and authentication implementation beyond the public registration surface was not part of the unauthenticated core journey.

paths.description: Homepage and update feed, representing discovery/listing and global chrome.
Manga detail template and chapter selection.
Chapter landing and primary INICIAR LECTURA action.
Primary reading view reached from the chapter landing.
Registration form representing account input and validation.

findings.summary: The site does not adapt to the user’s dark colour preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-emulation screenshot is visually identical to the light capture; computed html color-scheme is normal and the page background remains light.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface, text, link and control tokens.

findings.summary: Text and link treatments fail minimum contrast requirements.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports the section heading at 3.86:1, Popular badges at 3.68:1, and inline links at 1.51:1 against surrounding text.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose tokens meeting WCAG contrast minimums and add a non-colour link affordance such as an underline.

findings.summary: Semantic structure and keyboard focus are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse finds skipped heading levels and no main landmark; the focused mobile navigation button computes outline: none.
findings.suggestedFix: Add main/header/footer landmarks, use sequential headings, and define a clearly visible :focus-visible style for all controls.

findings.summary: Reusable content components only react to global viewport breakpoints.
findings.evidence: The runtime CSS probe found no @container rules even though cards and update rows appear in multiple column widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Define containment and use container queries for card typography, metadata and action layout, retaining viewport fallbacks.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly exposed on the navigation toggle.
findings.evidence: After programmatically focusing the first control, its computed outline is none; the mobile screenshot confirms the toggle is a primary control.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply :focus-visible outlines with adequate contrast and retain the generous touch target sizes already present.

findings.summary: Primary navigation and state changes use abrupt swaps.
findings.evidence: The CSS/runtime probe found no View Transition declarations on the listing/detail journey.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance route and list/detail state changes with same-document or cross-document View Transitions, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: The very long update feed provides no scroll-aware orientation.
findings.evidence: The homepage is about 34,841 CSS px tall on mobile, while screenshots and CSS inspection show static navigation and no progress or scroll-state treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrained scroll-state-aware header or progress cue, preserving content space and reduced-motion preferences.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is far outside the good range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 11.0 s and FCP at 3.4 s; the trace corroborated LCP at 3.34 s under a different run, showing material run-to-run network sensitivity.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP asset, shorten redirect/document latency, and defer non-critical images, CSS and scripts.

findings.summary: The homepage transfers an excessive number and weight of image resources.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 634 requests and 12,928,452 transferred bytes, including 602 image requests and 12,195,824 image bytes; Lighthouse estimates 8,318 KiB cache and 3,255 KiB image-delivery savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Paginate or virtualise the feed, lazy-load below-fold media natively, serve responsive modern formats, and set durable cache headers on immutable assets.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable legacy and unused CSS/JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 241 KiB unused JavaScript and 61 KiB unused CSS; the DOM lists jQuery, jQuery UI, Bootstrap and multiple plugins loaded globally.
findings.suggestedFix: Inventory route-level needs, remove redundant plugins, and conditionally load non-critical code.

findings.summary: Document semantics and image dimensions are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse and the images primitive find the logo and all 21 sampled images without explicit width/height; html lacks lang and the page has no main landmark.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions or aspect-ratio, html lang="es", and semantic page landmarks.

findings.summary: Caching and browser-platform hygiene prevent fast return navigation.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports five BFCache failure reasons, including Cache-Control: no-store and WebSocket use, plus DevTools cookie issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unnecessary no-store and persistent connection blockers from public content pages and resolve browser Issues panel warnings.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are incomplete and crawler requests encounter redirect friction.
findings.evidence: The live DOM has no canonical URL, /sitemap.xml returns 404, and raw fetch/discoverability encountered a repeated Cloudflare redirect while the no-JS browser view itself remained readable.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a sitemap, add self-referential canonicals, and configure the edge challenge so standards-compliant crawlers can fetch stable 200 responses.

findings.summary: Transport and session-cookie protections are incomplete.
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but headers found no CSP, HSTS or nosniff; PHPSESSID is neither Secure nor HttpOnly and all eight observed cookies use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a restrictive CSP, HSTS and nosniff; make session cookies Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is required.

findings.summary: Tracking runs immediately with a broad cookie and request footprint.
findings.evidence: The trackers primitive found Google Analytics and Yandex Metrika, eight third-party origins, and Yandex cookie-sync traffic; Lighthouse recorded 18 third-party cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise analytics, load it only after an appropriate consent choice, avoid cookie syncing, and shorten identifiers and retention.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced defence policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Headers show X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, but no Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP frame-ancestors or HSTS.
findings.suggestedFix: Set explicit Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy and consolidate clickjacking/XSS defence in a tested CSP.

findings.summary: The Spanish document does not declare its language.
findings.evidence: The rendered DOM has html lang="" and Lighthouse fails html-has-lang, despite Spanish content and metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang="es" on every template, add dir where needed, and prefer logical CSS properties in shared layouts.

findings.summary: The registration form omits autocomplete assistance.
findings.evidence: All email, username and password fields return an empty autocomplete property, including the repeated password field.
findings.suggestedFix: Add email, username, new-password and appropriate confirmation semantics so password managers and autofill can assist.

findings.summary: The image-heavy feed is not delivered within a proportionate resource budget.
findings.evidence: HAR transferred 12.2 MB across 602 image requests; the image probe found no modern-format sampled images, 20 below-fold images without native lazy loading and missing responsive sources.
findings.suggestedFix: Cap the initial feed, use AVIF/WebP responsive variants, reserve dimensions and lazy-load below-fold assets.

findings.summary: Third-party and background resource use is disproportionate for a content index.
findings.evidence: Eight third-party origins and active analytics accompany a 12.9 MB, 634-request load before user interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-essential analytics and media, remove redundant trackers, and enforce per-template request and byte budgets.

taskList.title: Cut the homepage image/request payload and fix LCP
Harden security headers and session cookies
Minimise consentless analytics and cookie syncing
Repair landmarks, headings, focus and contrast
Add intrinsic image dimensions and remove unused legacy bundles
Add canonical/sitemap signals and stabilise crawler responses
